# HVE-Forge for VS Code

Follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md`. Use the shared HVE custom agents under `.claude/agents`, file-specific rules under `.github/instructions`, and skills under `.claude/skills`.

VS Code hooks are intentionally not enabled by default. Use the HVE CLI for deterministic policy, replay, evidence, rendering checks, and host diagnostics.
